execution_stage_observation.interpretation: The retained P2 summaries observe group-level CPU output stages on equal-length multi-request decode batches. The three-case structural test reproduces one sufficient compaction condition (zero-service unindexed shared synchronization) but does not prove it explains every historical batch. No production patch or score was run.

reachable_path_analysis.interpretation: Existing retained batch schedules contain multi-request equal-length decode batches. This establishes reachability of the equal-length source path as a workload shape, but retained aggregate predictions still do not prove that compact execution assigned the row stages to the expected execution stages.

request_pair_deltas.interpretation: At the declared descriptive 1e-9 ms threshold, 5 cells (16 requests) have endpoint metric differences; the same 5 cells have median differences, with 0 aggregation-masking cells. Maximum last-token delta is 0.0054931640625 ns. These small differences do not establish their floating-point origin or any middle-token behavior. No acceptance tolerance was changed.

summary.threshold_scope: descriptive diagnostics only; not an error-acceptance rule or proof of rounding cause

source_review.candidate_direction: non_active_followup_direction: if later authorized, derive from R0 with necessary row semantics and explicitly separate shared zero-service synchronization from row-owned completion; do not start automatically

facts.claim: qualification checks source sampler, stable admission/vector order, backend_sampling=false, unique request/lane identities, but does not require item_index to be integer
row stage metadata carries binding.item_index; non-int/bool item_index is skipped when building row_terminal_by_item
item terminal uses row terminal IDs when present and otherwise falls back to completion dependencies; aggregate serving resolver can fall back from terminal stage to group completion
formal paired predictions use aggregate retention and diagnostic events were not requested; absent terminal fields are therefore an evidence gap, not proof of fallback
current slot engine timing is updated after sampling/accept and before token-to-piece/text processing; request token completion and slot/context reuse remain separate boundaries

source_review.first_mismatch: R3 bounded structural diagnosis: for the tested TaskExecutionRecord inputs, an unindexed zero-service shared output synchronization record is merged into the CPU output set and prevents row split, producing a group-level stage; without that record or with a positive-service device output, two row stages remain. This proves the tested compaction condition only. Normal lane integer item_index propagation is ruled out on the reviewed path. Historical group-stage causes, plural-group mapping, cache/remap and online terminal propagation remain unverified. No production candidate or accuracy result.
source_review.first_observable_mismatch: Formal P2 equal-length multi-request decode batches retain one group-named cpu_output_commit stage rather than row-named compact stages. This is an observed group-level representation; the R3 structural test reproduces a bounded zero-service shared-record compaction condition. The cause of all historical batches remains unverified, including plural-group mapping, cache/remap, and online terminal propagation.

normal_lane_item_index_negative_finding.claim: normal lane construction enumerates cohort items into integer item_index, identity_metadata emits it, and qualification copies it; missing-index explanation is ruled out on this reviewed path but cache/remap/compaction/online terminal propagation remain unverified
